Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

could you write up a dinner calendar for our family for may 4 through 10, 2026? it's four of us and i only need dinners, not breakfasts or lunches. aim for meals that make sense for a normal week, nothing fancy. we have rice, canned tomatoes, and carrots already, so work those in where they fit, but don't treat them as the only ingredients we can use. mara avoids mushrooms, and don't schedule fish on thursday. tuesday is the late soccer day and we'd like dinner ready by 6; friday should be lentil soup if possible? the exact notes i was sent are “Tuesday is late soccer, so dinner needs to be ready by 6.” and “Please save Friday for the lentil soup.” use those as part of the request, not as extra meals or a separate section. give me one dinner per day, with the meal name and a short ingredient list for each, and keep the dates clear. don't make a shopping list, and there's no need to write recipes. if one of the existing ingredients doesn't fit naturally, it can be left unused. please make it easy to scan, maybe a table or a simple dated list, whichever reads better.", "output": "Create an easy-to-scan dinner calendar for our family of four for May 4–10, 2026. Include one dinner per day, with the date, meal name, and a short ingredient list. Use a table or a simple dated list, whichever is clearer.

Plan ordinary, unfussy meals for a normal week. We already have rice, canned tomatoes, and carrots; use them where they fit, but they do not need to be the only ingredients, and any that do not fit naturally may be left unused. Mara avoids mushrooms, and do not schedule fish on Thursday.

Please account for these notes: “Tuesday is late soccer, so dinner needs to be ready by 6.” and “Please save Friday for the lentil soup.” Aim to have lentil soup on Friday if possible.

Include dinners only, not breakfasts or lunches. Do not include a shopping list or recipes."}]
